body:
Kanban BPTUNE-10001, continuing the tuning pass (Medusa's Serpents' Grasp, Raccoon's Play Dead, Second Tree's Regrowth, now Uncrowned's Cast Doubt). Real, deliberate contrast to Uncrowned's Claim (purely self-facing, no offense at all): drains a nearby opponent's own shield_health (BRAWLPIT_CAST_DOUBT_SHIELD_DAMAGE=20.0) -- the first Uncrowned move that reaches another player at all -- while still dealing real, deliberate zero damage_percent, a design boundary kept on purpose. Shares turnip_cooldown with the neutral-B. New test_uncrowned_cast_doubt confirms the real shield drain and zero damage. bash scripts/build.sh clean, all 10 physics tests pass. README updated. BRAWLPIT commit 311e63a. Real, honest, still open: Vexar, Sunlit Draw, Sequel Duck each still need their own down-B. session: sess-20260902-2008-ed50169e

⚓ ☃
title: BPTUNE-10001: Uncrowned's Cast Doubt -- fourth real down-B, shield-drain contrast to the top-up
